refreshPolicy.matchWindow: 90 minutes before kickoff through 150 minutes after kickoff
notes: Daily refresh checks official FIFA calendar and squad source status.
Match-window refresh checks official status, score, tactics, and lineup exposure more aggressively.
Google probability widgets are never used as model truth.

pattern.label: Korea-style mixed lane
pattern.stance: Canada has the edge, but draw plus Bosnia and Herzegovina is high enough that first-goal and comeback paths matter.

drivers: Canada grades stronger on FIFA rank and host venue context.
Bosnia and Herzegovina narrows the model through recent form and squad goal depth.
Lineups are not official until actual starter names or formations are exposed by an official/team source.

matches.venue: SoFi Stadium / Los Angeles Stadium, Inglewood

pattern.label: Favorite edge with late-goal risk
pattern.stance: The United States is the clearer favorite, but recent scoring and concession data says the match can stay live late.

drivers: The United States grades stronger on FIFA rank, host venue context, average caps, and squad goal depth.
Paraguay recent form keeps the away outcome alive.
Lineups are not official until actual starter names or formations are exposed by an official/team source.
